endpoint.address: documented DB v1 URL map; exact pool

201.description: New cluster creation has been started.

400.description: Bad request. Fix the request and try again.

401.description: Bad or expired token. You can reissue the token and try again.

403.description: Access is forbidden. Make sure you have the required rights.

request.identity: scope from immutable view; existing resource addressed by exact scoped ResourceRef; no name lookup
request.optional_fields: nil omitted; explicit false/zero/empty preserved where permitted by schema; raw datetime string retained

body.datastore: All DatastoreCreate schema fields; project_id from immutable scope; explicit differing project rejected; protected config and redis_password revealed only at request boundary

request.validation: Required fields and nested required fields; name pattern/length; positive node_count, sizes and retention; disk enums; floating IP ranges including replica <= node_count-1; pooler enum/range; unique nonempty security groups; nonempty restore source; UTF-8 and password length; config JSON object. UUID existence and engine compatibility remain provider checks, without hidden discovery calls.

response.field_mapping: All datastore schema properties; optional presence preserved; arbitrary-precision integers; provider datetime strings retained verbatim; provider ref field discarded
response.resource_ref: Create requires nonempty provider ID. Exact Get/Update use request ref when optional response ID is absent; a present response ID must match. List refs only for returned IDs. Scope, endpoint and generation from the call.

errors.404: not_found for safe reads; mutation rejection only when documented
errors.transport_loss: unknown_outcome after possible mutation transmission; exact request refs preserved
errors.malformed_accepted_response: protocol_error with accepted Receipt and trustworthy provider IDs already extracted
errors.message: fixed SDK message; raw provider messages discarded
errors.foreign_project: scope_mismatch; no resource ref from a foreign project

retry: bounded safe reads; mutation single attempt, never replay

wait.unknown: state_unknown, preserve raw provider state; missing status also unknown
wait.meaning: provider ACTIVE only; no SQL/application/configuration readiness claim
wait.budget: shared WaitTimeout/context deadline, per-read CallTimeout, PollInterval

recovery.availability: exact resource observation only when ref exists; never replay creation or look up by name
recovery.unknown: resource observation does not prove authorship; outcome remains unknown
recovery.resume: same account, scope, endpoint, generation, operation and contract revision required; binding uses no I/O
